'''''Daen nosi''''' was a term in the [[Anzat (language)|Anzat language]] referring to the "fate lines" that [[Kell Douro]] saw, giving him insight into the possible futures of people and places. He was slightly disturbed that he could not see ''daen nosi'' on a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. This seemed to be a rare ability as when Kell Douro told other [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] of this they thought him mad.
